module.purpose: Provides the React entry point for constructing, configuring, mounting, loading, and displaying a tldraw editor, including store selection, theming, licensing, error handling, persistence, synchronization, and lifecycle integration.
module.summary: This module defines the public editor component props and React components that assemble a tldraw editor from either a supplied store, a synchronized store, or a locally created store. It registers themes, merges deprecated options, applies defaults, manages loading and crash states, creates and disposes the editor instance, synchronizes camera and theme changes, handles focus behavior, loads fonts, provides editor context, and exposes lifecycle and loading/error UI helpers.
module.businessContext: Supports the embedded collaborative drawing editor used to create and edit tldraw documents. Failures affect document rendering, persistence or synchronization, editor startup, user interaction, and error recovery.

detail.name: TldrawEditor
detail.signature: ({ store, components, className, user: _user, options: _options, textOptions: _textOptions, deepLinks: _deepLinks, ...rest }: TldrawEditorProps)
preconditions: The supplied props must conform to TldrawEditorProps.
If a store is supplied, it must be a supported ready Store or synced store shape.
postconditions: A root application container is rendered with tldraw container semantics and the resolved CSS class.
Themes from the props are resolved and their colors and fonts are registered before child editor rendering.
Missing shapeUtils, bindingUtils, assetUtils, and tools values are replaced with empty arrays.
A user object is available to the child editor, using the supplied user or a newly created current user.
The supplied options object takes precedence over deprecated textOptions and deepLinks values when those corresponding options are already defined.
A supplied ready Store is rendered through the ready-store path; a supplied synced store is rendered through the loading-store path; without a store, the editor uses the own-store path.
invariants: The root element has role application, is not draggable, and has tabIndex -1.
The root aria-label is the options branding value when present, otherwise it is tldraw.
Deprecated textOptions and deepLinks do not override defined values in options.
The error boundary annotates errors originating before the application with the react.tldraw-before-app origin tag.
edgeCases: When store is undefined, the component does not render a store-backed child until its container exists and delegates store creation to the own-store path.
When store is a ready Store instance, it bypasses the syncing/loading path.
When store is a synced non-Store value, it delegates syncing stages to the loading-store path.
When themes is absent or resolves to no themes, theme registration still runs with the resolved result.
When components.ErrorFallback is undefined, the default error fallback is used.
When className is absent, the root still receives the tldraw container and light-theme classes.
When options contains text or deepLinks values, deprecated textOptions and deepLinks values are ignored for those fields.
